=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:805-835 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_env_split_string_has_guarded_git` treats unresolved shell expansions in `env -S` arguments as literal text, so it can miss a guarded Git push or commit.
  WHY: The detector and subsequent top-level check can both miss the expanded Git operation, allowing it to execute without the merged-PR guard.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:817-832 | severity=critical | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_env_split_string_has_guarded_git` limits recursive split-string detection to 4 levels, potentially leaving deeper command constructions unanalyzed.
  WHY: An attacker-controlled command could exceed the recursion limit and execute a push without destination checks.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:829-833 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A `ValueError` from recursively parsing an unparseable split-string is not caught, so the detector can raise instead of falling open to a confirmation prompt.
  WHY: The exception can propagate out of hook payload evaluation, potentially leaving the guarded command without a prompt or block.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: 1607-1608; also workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py same lines | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The check for `invocation.warning == "could not verify git push configuration overrides"` is dead code because that warning is no longer generated.
  WHY: The condition misleads maintainers about the guard’s behavior; reviewers agree it is dead code and rate it NIT.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py: lines ~1570-1578 in the original PR diff; 1570-1578 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `test_explicit_non_github_pushurl_is_not_rewritten` assumes a non-GitHub push URL will be blocked even when `pushInsteadOf` may rewrite its effective destination to GitHub.
  WHY: If Git applies the rewrite, the guard allows the effective GitHub destination and the assertion fails; reviewers disagree on whether this rewrite applies to an explicitly configured `pushurl` and on the certainty and severity of the test failure.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Block pushes to non-GitHub destinations before they run; request confirmation when the destination cannot be resolved.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The current patch handles non-GitHub destinations when Git configuration involves URL rewriting, but if an explicit literal pushURL is provided that directly resolves to a non-GitHub destination (without Git-level URL rewriting), the implementation relies on destination label verification and may not consistently trigger interactive confirmation for all unresolvable destination cases.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
